messages.content: tor kache ekta jinis jigges korbo, tumi ki mone koro forgiveness mane forget kore jawa?
Na, forgiveness ar forgetting alada jinis amar mote. Forgive kora manei abar exact same trust deya na, boundary shoho o forgive kora jai. Tumi kono specific situation bhabcho?
hae, ekjon ke forgive korte chai but abar age er moto trust korte pari na

That's completely reasonable, and honestly healthier than pretending nothing happened. Forgiveness releases the resentment you're carrying, it doesn't obligate you to rebuild trust at the same pace or level as before.
